assets.name: laptop-code
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: website editorial cover photograph
Primary request: create an original natural photographic image of a dark laptop showing abstract unreadable lines of code on a clean navy and gray workspace.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet contemporary desk, uncluttered, dark navy and charcoal surroundings.
Subject: one open unbranded laptop on a clean gray desk, its screen showing only softly blurred, unreadable abstract code-like lines.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, wide editorial composition, natural perspective from a slightly elevated side angle, the complete laptop is visible.
Lighting/mood: atmospheric cool window light, subdued soft shadows, focused and calm, realistic photography with subtle texture.
Color palette: navy, charcoal gray, cool blue highlights, restrained neutral whites.
Constraints: no people, no hands, no readable text, no logos, no branding, no overlay text, no watermark; photograph only, no website layout, no interface mockup.
